partnershipPlan: A care home sector representative sits on the safety panel; two local health unit nurses review the escalation rule before January.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: After twenty false alarms in a row you start clicking dismiss before you have really looked.
items.implication: Keep the artefact checks quick so attention is left for the rest.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: By the time anyone rang us, half the residents on one floor were ill.
items.implication: Make the care home check explicit and review every dismissed true event.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Every escalation lands on my desk; I would rather have fewer that are real.
items.implication: Report escalations per 100 alerts as a secondary outcome.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: In a town our size, three sick children at the clinic is already an outbreak.
items.implication: Report dismissals by rural and urban area.

summary: Four composite voices on alert fatigue, care homes, escalation workload and small communities.
